Hydride and carbon trapping afford enantioenriched diarylalkanes and products bearing acyclic all-carbon quaternary stereocenters in up to 99% yield and 99% ee. Experimental and computational studies support competition between direct cation trapping and elimination followed by alkene protonation, with the balance depending on nucleophile reactivity. These findings establish intramolecular alkene protonation as a strategy for incorporating elimination into productive asymmetric catalysis.
items.authors: Jin Won Lee, Hyojae Jung, Hayoung Song, Injoo Seo, Do Hyun Ryu

items.title: Instantaneous Mechanical Programming of Polymer Microparticle Shape and Surface Architecture
items.abstract: Structurally anisotropic polymer microparticles with controlled surface topographies are essential for applications in selfassembly, interfacial engineering, and responsive materials. However, practical methods for fabricating such complex morphologies remain limited. Here, we demonstrate an instantaneous mechanically driven strategy for simultaneously programming particle shape and surface architecture through a refined rubbing process. By optimizing particle plasticization, pressure distribution, and stress transmission, spherical polymer particles were transformed into cylindrical particles within only 10 s. Patterned silicon substrates enabled direct mechanical transfer of periodic surface structures, while variations in substrate topology and deformation pathway produced diverse anisotropic architectures. This simple mechanically driven process provides a straightforward platform for programming hierarchical polymer microparticle architectures.
items.authors: Tomoki Nakagami, Akihide Arima, Mayuka Mishima, Asuka Ishii, Makusu Tsutsui, Takuya Matsumoto

items.title: Constructing safe and highly potent antiviral neutralising nanodevices using a ferritin-based plug-and-play molecular assembly platform
items.abstract: Viral infections are a global threat. Vaccines and antiviral drugs take years to develop, and few options exist for rapid response to viral outbreaks. To address this gap in pandemic preparedness, we advance a “plug-and-play” nanocage assembly platform for constructing antiviral nanodevices (AVNs), defined as nanocages that physically bind viral surface glycoproteins and block entry and infection. Using a multidisciplinary approach combining molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, biochemical assays, Cryo-EM structural analysis, and antiviral assays, we show that different antiviral lectins can be genetically fused to assembly precursors designed by linking two ferritin subunits with an intrinsically disordered peptide (IDP) containing an enterokinase cleavage site. The resulting precursors significantly improved ( 2-fold) lectin binding to glycans and assembled into AVNs with a core structure resembling a ferritin nanocage. We show that AVNs have potent activity against influenza A virus (IAV) (IC50 values 1 nM), with no toxicity observed in ex vivo precision-cut lung slices (PCLS). Our data revealed insight into precursor design rules and suggest a stepwise mechanism of nanocage assembly. These findings pave the way for using AVNs to develop novel antiviral preventive strategies and provide fundamental insights into nanocage assembly.
items.authors: Yujie Sheng, Yasmin M. Surani, Alina Jansen, Mickaël V. Cherrier, Lydie Martin, Elcin Su Karavelioglu

items.title: Iso-co-humulone Does Not Necessarily Contribute to the Roughness of Beer Bitterness
items.abstract: [Conclusion] Iso-co-humulone does not necessarily contribute to the roughness of beer bitterness. The long-repeated rule that a high cohumulone proportion produces rough, harsh, or lingering bitterness should not be accepted as a general law of brewing and should not be used by itself to judge hop quality or to predict the sensory quality of beer. [Background] The cohumulone–roughness hypothesis has been reproduced for decades in brewing literature, referenceworks, trainingmaterials, andhop-selectionpractice, despite limiteddirect evidence and timeintensity findings inconsistentwith a simple universal rule. This persistence is consequential: brewers, particularly those entering the field, may reject otherwise suitable hops or misdiagnose rough bitterness solely from a cohumulone specification. [Methods] Fractions containing iso-co-humulone, iso-normal-humulone, or iso-ad-humulone (each combining its cis and trans forms) were added separately to unhopped beer at 25 BU. Lingering bitter aftertaste was evaluated blind by six trained panelists on a nine-point anchored scale and by a lipid-membrane taste-sensing system. In a separate 3,000-L brewing comparison, the iso-co-humulone proportion was increased from 28.2% to 39.8%; eight trained panelists performed blind paired comparisons of lingering aftertaste and bitterness crispness (kire). [Results]Mean lingering-bitterness scores were 4.9, 6.2, and 6.9 for iso-co-humulone, iso-normal-humulone, and iso-ad-humulone, respectively. Corresponding taste-sensor aftertaste responses were 0.24, 2.89, and 2.73. In the brewing comparison, aftertaste choices were divided 4:4, whereas seven of eight panelists selected the higheriso-co-humulone beer as having greater crispness (one-sided exact p = 0.035; two-sided p = 0.070). [Interpretation] Roughness was not measured as a separate multidimensional attribute, and the brewing comparison was not independently replicated. Nevertheless, the convergent model-beer, sensor, and brewing observations contradict the necessary-persistence premise of the traditional roughness rule and do not justify treating a high iso-co-humulone proportion as automatic evidence of rough beer bitterness. A cohumulone percentage on a hop specification is not a sensory verdict.
items.authors: Toru KISHIMOTO

items.title: Reductive Electrophotocatalysis: Fundamentals, Mechanistic Frameworks, and Synthetic Applications
items.abstract: Reductive electrophotocatalysis has emerged as a powerful synthetic platform that combines electrochemistry and photoredox catalysis to achieve exceptionally strong reduction potentials under mild conditions. Through sequential electrochemical reduction and photoexcitation, highly reactive excited-state radical ions are generated, which can activate challenging substrates that are often difficult to address with conventional catalytic methods. Consequently, this approach has unlocked a broad range of previously unattainable reductive transformations. This review seeks to provide a comprehensive overview of the fundamental principles, catalyst design strategies, and mechanistic aspects of reductive electrophotocatalysis, with particular emphasis on the ongoing debate surrounding the identity of the reducing species responsible for substrate activation. Special attention is devoted to the four mechanistic pathways currently proposed in the literature: (i) direct electron transfer from the excited photocatalyst radical anion, (ii) substrate activation facilitated by pre-association between the photocatalyst radical anion and the substrate (iii) reduction through solvated electrons or related electron-pool mechanisms, (iv) reduction mediated by catalyst-derived or modified photocatalyst species. In addition, representative electrophotocatalyst systems and their applications in reductive bond activation will be critically evaluated. Finally, future opportunities for the development of sustainable, selective, and scalable electrophotocatalytic methodologies will be highlighted, with particular focus on advancing mechanistic understanding.
items.authors: Hasil Aman, Tobias Edmaier, Mehmet Yildirim, Ruzal Sitdikov, Oscar Verho
items.title_zh: 还原性电光催化：基础、机制框架与合成应用
items.summary_zh: 还原性电光催化作为一种强大的合成平台，结合了电化学和光氧化还原催化，在温和条件下实现了极强的还原电位。通过电化学还原与光激发的序列过程，生成高度反应性的激发态自由基离子，能够激活传统催化方法难以处理的底物。因此，该方法开启了一系列以往无法实现的还原转化。本文综述了还原性电光催化的基本原理、催化剂设计策略及机制方面，特别强调了关于底物激活的还原物种身份的争论。重点讨论了文献中提出的四种机制路径： (i) 来自激发光催化剂自由基阴离子的直接电子转移，(ii) 光催化剂自由基阴离子与底物的预结合促进底物激活，(iii) 通过溶剂化电子或相关电子池机制的还原，(iv) 由催化剂衍生或修饰的光催化剂物种介导的还原。此外，介绍了代表性的电光催化剂系统及其在还原反应中的应用。
items.l1_lead: 还原性电光催化通过结合电化学与光催化，在温和条件下实现高效的还原转化，开启了处理传统方法难以应对的底物的新途径。
items.l2_summary:
还原性电光催化是一种新兴的合成平台，结合了电化学和光氧化还原催化的优势，能够在温和条件下实现高效的还原反应。该方法通过电化学还原与光激发的序列过程，生成高度反应性的激发态自由基离子，这些离子能够有效激活传统催化方法难以处理的底物，从而实现一系列以往无法达到的还原转化。本文综述了还原性电光催化的基本原理、催化剂设计策略及其机制，特别关注了关于底物激活的还原物种身份的争论。

在机制方面，文献中提出了四种主要的路径来解释还原性电光催化的过程。首先，激发光催化剂自由基阴离子可以通过直接电子转移的方式参与反应。其次，光催化剂自由基阴离子与底物的预结合能够促进底物的激活。第三，通过溶剂化电子或相关电子池机制的还原也被认为是一个重要的路径。最后，由催化剂衍生或修饰的光催化剂物种也可能在还原过程中发挥重要作用。

此外，本文还介绍了代表性的电光催化剂系统及其在还原反应中的应用，展示了这一领域的广泛潜力和实际应用前景。通过对这些机制的深入探讨，研究者们能够更好地理解还原性电光催化的工作原理，从而推动其在合成化学中的应用发展。总的来说，还原性电光催化为化学合成提供了一种新的思路，具有重要的理论价值和实际意义。

items.title: A residue-50 crystallographic B-factor scalar tracks catalytic-efficiency ordering across HG Kemp eliminase evolution
items.abstract: Active-site pre-organisation is a well-characterised contributor to enzyme catalysis, and progressive rigidification of catalytic residues during HG-series Kemp eliminase evolution — including decreasing structure-normalised B-factor Z-scores at the position-50 residue — has already been reported directly from room-temperature crystallography (Broom et al., 2020). The contribution here is therefore not that observation, but a bounded quantitative test of how completely a single compact scalar recovers catalytic-efficiency ordering within an HG Kemp eliminase series, together with an explicit account of where that scalar fails to transfer. In the primary HG dataset — five room-temperature structures from the directed-evolution series plus the separately engineered variant HG4 — the residue-50 side-chain scalar correlated with log10(kcat/KM) at r = −0.9899 (p = 1.52 × 10-4) and reproduced the catalytic-efficiency ordering of the archived scalar values exactly (Spearman ρ = −1.000; exact two-sided permutation p = 0.0028). Restricting the analysis to the five evolutionary-series variants gave r = −0.9893. The association is robust to the choice of published kinetic dataset. In four independently designed HG variants the multi-residue active-site scalar was directionally negative (r = −0.7759) but weak on a rank basis (ρ = −0.400; exact two-sided p = 0.75) and is treated as neither replication nor support of comparable weight. Application of the same extraction logic to an independent KE07 scaffold failed a pre-committed robustness criterion and is reported as a negative transfer result. Two distinct sensitivities are separated there: a normalization correction, and an additional dependence on which deposited structure represents each variant across all 48 pre-declared combinations. We do not claim that the specificity of the primary single-residue scalar has been established: the archived negative controls were computed on a four-residue active-site average, not on the primary scalar, and their generating workflow is not fully archived. B-factors are treated throughout as operational crystallographic observables rather than as measurements of solution dynamics. The result is a narrowly scoped, reproducible descriptive reanalysis of public data with a clearly documented limit on transfer — not a causal mechanism, a specificity demonstration, or a generalisation to other reaction classes.
items.authors: Mahesh babu Sodalagunta

items.title: Total Synthesis: Backbone of Organic Chemistry, a Discipline in Decline?
items.abstract: Total synthesis has long been regarded as the intellectual backbone of organic chemistry, driving reaction discovery, stereoselective methodology, and molecular design. Yet its place within the contemporary discipline is actively debated, largely on the basis of editorial opinion rather than evidence. In this Perspective we bring quantitative data to that debate. We examined the annual share of articles carrying the phrase “total synthesis” in their titles across four leading journals—Angewandte Chemie International Edition, Journal of Organic Chemistry, Organic Letters, and Tetrahedron Letters—from 1959 to 2025. The share rose through the late twentieth century to a peak of about 4.79% in 2009, then fell to 1.85% by 2025, a relative decline of roughly 61%. Structural-break analysis places a consistent inflection near 2020, and an AIC-selected ARIMA(0,1,0) model with drift projects continued decline to about 1.40% by 2030. Crucially, the fall is relative rather than absolute: the annual number of total syntheses has held broadly steady while overall journal output has expanded dramatically. We argue that total synthesis is not disappearing but being diluted and redefined, and we outline how researchers, editors, and funding agencies might sustain it as a driver of innovation.
items.authors: B. Meghana, Sofiya Sultana, S. Chandrasekhar, Motahar Reza

items.title: Rhodium-Catalyzed Stereoselective Access to Polysubstituted Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes Bearing Quaternary Bridge Carbons
items.abstract: Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes (BCBs) are unique strained carbocycles that have emerged as attractive buildingblocks in synthetic and medicinal chemistry owing to their unique reactivity. Despite recent advances in the preparation of polysubstituted BCBs, the stereoselective synthesis of bridge-substituted derivatives remains a significant challenge, particularly when quaternary stereocenters are involved at these positions. Herein, we report a rhodium-catalyzed [2+1] cycloaddition of cyclopropenes and diazo compounds that provides direct access to stereodefined bridge-substituted BCBs. The reaction proceeds with complete diastereocontrol across a broad range of substrates and enables the construction of densely functionalized frameworks bearing up to four stereocenters. The methodology can also be extended to enantioenriched cyclopropenes, providing optically active BCBs with complete enantiospecificity. DFT calculations are consistent with the stereochemical outcome and the synthetic utility of the resulting BCBs is demonstrated by transformations leading to fused tricyclic architectures and polysubstituted cyclobutenes and cyclobutanes.
items.authors: Guillermo Morales-Ortega, Estíbaliz Merino, R. Martín Romero, Javier Carreras
items.title_zh: 铑催化的立体选择性合成多取代桥碳的Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes
items.summary_zh: Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes（BCBs）是一类独特的应变碳环，因其独特的反应性在合成和药物化学中备受关注。尽管在多取代BCBs的制备方面已有进展，但桥取代衍生物的立体选择性合成仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是涉及四面体立体中心时。本文报道了一种铑催化的[2+1]环加成反应，利用环丙烯和二氮化合物直接合成立体定义的桥取代BCBs。该反应在广泛的底物范围内实现了完全的非对映选择性，并能够构建具有多达四个立体中心的密集功能化框架。此外，该方法还可扩展至富含对映体的环丙烯，提供具有完全对映特异性的光学活性BCBs。DFT计算结果与立体化学结果一致，合成的BCBs的实用性通过转化为融合的三环结构和多取代的环丁烯及环丁烷得以证明。
items.l1_lead: 本文报道了一种铑催化的[2+1]环加成反应，成功实现了多取代桥碳Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes的立体选择性合成，具有广泛的底物适用性和高对映选择性。
items.l2_summary:
Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes（BCBs）是一类具有独特应变特性的碳环，因其特殊的反应性在合成和药物化学领域受到广泛关注。尽管在多取代BCBs的合成方面已有一定进展，但在桥取代衍生物的立体选择性合成，尤其是涉及四面体立体中心时，仍然面临显著挑战。为此，本文报道了一种铑催化的[2+1]环加成反应，利用环丙烯和二氮化合物直接合成立体定义的桥取代BCBs。该反应在多种底物的应用中实现了完全的非对映选择性，能够构建具有多达四个立体中心的密集功能化框架，显示出其广泛的适用性和高效性。

此外，该方法还可以扩展至富含对映体的环丙烯，成功提供具有完全对映特异性的光学活性BCBs。通过密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，研究结果与立体化学的实验结果相一致，进一步验证了该反应的有效性和可靠性。合成的BCBs的实用性得到了证明，通过转化为融合的三环结构以及多取代的环丁烯和环丁烷，展示了其在后续化学反应中的潜在应用。这项研究不仅为多取代BCBs的合成提供了新的策略，也为相关领域的研究提供了重要的理论基础和实践指导。

items.title: Biosynthetic Plausibility Mapper: Reaction-Aware Prioritization of Plant Metabolite Candidates Using Curated Pathway Context
items.abstract: Untargeted plant metabolomics can generate numerous structurally plausible annotations and candidate structures, but structural similarity alone does not establish whether a compound is consistent with the biosynthetic context represented by the detected metabolome. Integrating curated biochemical relationships with chemical similarity could therefore provide an additional, interpretable layer for candidate prioritization. Here, we present Biosynthetic Plausibility Mapper (BPM), an open-source cheminformatics application that maps user-provided plant metabolite annotations onto a locally constructed PlantCyc-derived knowledge base and explicitly distinguishes detected compounds, curated pathway context, and computationally prioritized candidates. BPM integrates chemical-identity reconciliation, curated reaction and pathway relationships, structural similarity, and global-context coherence into a decomposable candidate-ranking framework. In pathway-based benchmarking against hard structural decoys, BPM v3.1 achieved AUROC and AUPRC values of 1.000 and ranked the reference compound first in all 20 trials. In a more stringent adversarial benchmark containing biosynthetically plausible alternatives, v3.1 improved AUROC from 0.920 to 0.985, AUPRC from 0.574 to 0.837, and Top-1 accuracy from 65% to 90% relative to v3. A compact phenylpropanoid–flavonoid example illustrates the separation of experimental annotations, curated context, and prioritized hypotheses, while a larger Arabidopsis occurrence dataset demonstrates application to 864 mapped compounds within a 6,714-node network. BPM therefore provides an interpretable framework for converting annotated plant metabolite lists into ranked biosynthetic hypotheses without conflating computational plausibility with compound identification. By combining curated biochemical context with structural evidence and exporting prioritized candidates for targeted interrogation of LC–MS/MS data, BPM provides a practical link between metabolite annotation, biosynthetic interpretation, and subsequent experimental investigation.
items.authors: Lucas Jesus Patrício, Rômulo Pereira de Jesus, Ísis Tavares Vilas Boas, Fernanda Oliveira Chagas, Ricardo Moreira Borges

items.title: Surface-Induced Constraint Release in Confined Polymer Films: A Computational Phenomenological Study
items.abstract: Thin polymer films exhibit thickness-dependent viscoelastic behavior attributed to enhanced segmental mobility near free surfaces, a phenomenon recently linked to surface-induced constraint release (SICR) in entangled polymer melts. While self-consistent theoretical treatments of this mechanism exist, computationally lightweight phenomenological models that isolate the role of specific structural assumptions remain comparatively underexplored. This work showcases a developed closed-form, depth-resolved generalized Maxwell model in which local relaxation times are derived from a depth-dependent entanglement molecular weight profile, motivated by reptation scaling () and literature-reported surface entanglement enhancement ratios. With this framework, we directly compare two assumptions for combining depth-dependent relaxation behavior into an effective film modulus: a depth-independent linear superposition, and an entanglement-coupled, double-reptation-inspired mixing rule. Holding the underlying relaxation-time profile identical between both models, we find that the choice of coupling mechanism alters the predicted storage modulus by up to ~40%, with the divergence peaking at an intermediate film thickness rather than increasing monotonically as films thin. This work shows that the peak location is associated with, though not fully predicted by, the frequency-dependent heterogeneity of local relaxation times across the film. These results indicate that depth-coupling assumptions in phenomenological thin-film rheology models are not a minor implementation detail, but materially and non-trivially shape predicted thickness-dependent behavior, with implications for how such models should be constructed and interpreted going forward.
items.authors: Michael Castillo

items.title: Area-Selective Deposition of WS2 via Sacrificial ZnS Conversion at Low Temperatures
items.abstract: 2D transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) offer a promising path forward as standard silicon technology approaches its physical scaling limits. However, integrating TMDCs into semiconductor manufacturing requires precise, back-end-of-line (BEOL)-compatible deposition methods. Area-selective deposition (ASD) enables direct bottom-up patterning, yet achieving surface-selective growth of tungsten disulfide (WS 2 ) under low thermal budgets remains a significant challenge. Here, we demonstrate a thermally driven ASD route for ultra-thin WS 2 films at 400°C, using tungsten(VI) sulfide tetrachloride (WSCl 4 ) and H 2 S as precursors and leveraging the unique reactivity of the halogenated, sulfur-containing metal precursor to drive selective ligand exchange and conversion. This approach uses a sacrificial, ultra-thin ZnS template layer to guide spatial selectivity. The process selectively converts pre-deposited ZnS into high-quality WS 2 at 400°C while completely suppressing growth on adjacent dielectrics. Applied to 200 mm undoped silicate glass (USG) / Si(100) wafers, this precursor combination yields pure, smooth, ultra-thin ( 10 nm) crystalline WS 2 films with predominantly horizontally oriented layers. The surface conversion mechanism shows remarkable chemical contrast, with high selectivity (S 0.994) over 1200 deposition cycles, with USG as a non-growth area (NGA). Electrical measurements on tungsten-contacted transmission-line structures show functional behavior, yielding a layer resistivity of 2.9 × 10 7 µΩ·cm and a specific contact resistivity of 5.4×10 -3 Ω·cm 2 for ~7.5 nm WS 2 films. By leveraging sacrificial template conversion to enable highly selective, low-temperature thermal ASD of WS 2 , this work provides a scalable, chemistry-driven, direct, bottom-up integration of 2D materials into future advanced semiconductor device architectures.
items.authors: Nils Boysen, Akhil Unnikrishnan Nair, Marco Bürger, Leon Doman, Abdallah Alghazali, Katherine Guzey

items.title: Mixed thiolate/alkoxide antimony cages for stable reversed-bilayer vesicle self-assembly
items.abstract: A new two-step synthesis produces moisture-stable antimony and arsenic dithiothreitol cages. Structural analysis reveals that the Sb compounds self-assemble into reversed bilayers, consistent with pnictogen-bonded vesicle formation in organic media. The Sb assemblies more efficiently encapsulate and protect rhodamine B than the arsenic analogue or a topological mimic that lacks pnictogen-bonding capability. This work provides a synthetically accessible tool for partitioning organic media to allow for orthogonal reactivity.
items.authors: Lina M. Delgado, Olivia H. Villanueva, Shiva Moaven, Daniel K. Unruh, Dimitri Pappas, Anthony F. Cozzolino

items.title: The nature of metal-ligand interactions in different metalloporphyrin · · · hydrogen cyanide complexes: Limitations of DFT exchange-correlation functionals.
items.abstract: The weak intermolecular interaction energies of various metalloporphyrin (MP, M = Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, Zn) and hydrogen cyanide complexes along the axial metal-ligand bond have been computed using different wavefunction-based theoretical level (MP2, CCSD and CCSD(T)). The domain-based local pair natural orbital (DLPNO) method was applied at all three theoretical levels, as well as in the case of the MP2 theory, the spin-component and spin-opposite scaled frameworks were also taken into account. The nature of the interactions was analyzed by decomposing the intermolecular interaction energy into physically meaningful components (Electrostatic, Exchange, Dispersion, Non-dispersion and Perturbative triple) using the local energy decomposition (LED) method in the framework of the CCSD(T) theory. The potential energy curves were also compared with the results obtained using density functional theory ((DFT), considering sets of widely used exchange-correlation (XC) functionals, as well as the r2SCAN functional family. The behavior of DFT functionals is highly heterogeneous. For dispersion-dominant Ni, Zn and Mg cases of the interaction, the functionals underestimate the potential energy curves obtained by the CCSD and CCSD(T) methods. For the less dispersion-dominant Fe and Cr cases, where larger non-dispersion and triple perturbation (T) contributions were obtained, however, they overestimate the reference potential energy curves. This under-and overestimation can be linked to the exact exchange and correlation term used in the XC functional. Employing the MP2based component with a higher weight makes the XC functional’s behavior much more balanced. Overall, it was found that, the CAM-B3LYP, Pr2SCAN69, and our newly defined SCS1-r2SCAN0-2 (or r2SCAN0-2*, where the initail “SOS” form was replaced with “SCS”) functionals showed the most efficient performance.
items.authors: Alex-Adrian Farcaş, Attila Bende
items.title_zh: 不同金属卟啉与氰化氢复合物中金属-配体相互作用的性质
items.summary_zh: 本文计算了多种金属卟啉（MP，M = Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, Zn）与氰化氢复合物在轴向金属-配体键上的弱分子间相互作用能，采用了不同的波函数理论水平（MP2, CCSD 和 CCSD(T)）。在所有三个理论水平上应用了基于域的局部对自然轨道（DLPNO）方法，并在MP2理论中考虑了自旋分量和自旋相反缩放框架。通过局部能量分解（LED）方法，将分子间相互作用能分解为电静力、交换、色散、非色散和扰动三重等物理意义明确的成分，分析了相互作用的性质。此外，将势能曲线与密度泛函理论（DFT）下的结果进行了比较，考虑了广泛使用的交换-相关（XC）泛函集以及r2SCAN泛函族。DFT泛函的行为高度异质，对于色散主导的Ni、Zn和Mg相互作用，泛函低估了CCSD和CCSD(T)方法得到的势能曲线，而对于色散较弱的Fe和Cr情况，泛函则高估了非色散和三重扰动的贡献。
items.l1_lead: 不同金属卟啉与氰化氢复合物的金属-配体相互作用在不同理论水平下表现出显著差异，DFT泛函对色散主导和非色散主导相互作用的预测存在低估和高估现象。
items.l2_summary:
本文研究了多种金属卟啉（MP，M = Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, Zn）与氰化氢复合物中金属-配体键的弱分子间相互作用能，采用了多种波函数理论水平进行计算，包括MP2、CCSD和CCSD(T)。研究中应用了基于域的局部对自然轨道（DLPNO）方法，并在MP2理论中考虑了自旋分量和自旋相反缩放框架，以提高计算的准确性。通过局部能量分解（LED）方法，研究者将分子间相互作用能分解为电静力、交换、色散、非色散和扰动三重等物理意义明确的成分，从而深入分析了不同金属卟啉与氰化氢之间的相互作用性质。

在势能曲线的比较中，研究还考虑了密度泛函理论（DFT）下的结果，特别是广泛使用的交换-相关（XC）泛函集以及r2SCAN泛函族。研究发现，DFT泛函的行为高度异质，对于色散主导的Ni、Zn和Mg相互作用，DFT泛函通常低估了CCSD和CCSD(T)方法得到的势能曲线，而对于色散较弱的Fe和Cr情况，DFT泛函则高估了非色散和三重扰动的贡献。这些结果表明，不同金属卟啉与氰化氢的相互作用特性在理论计算中表现出显著差异，强调了选择合适的计算方法和理论框架的重要性，以准确描述金属-配体相互作用的复杂性。通过这些研究，本文为理解金属卟啉与氰化氢之间的相互作用提供了重要的理论依据和数据支持。

items.title: Mechanistic Insights into Light-Alkane Formation from Photoexcited Uranyl complexes
items.abstract: This work describes a uranyl-catalysed photo-induced methodology for generating methane from acetic acid. The reaction proceeds in water as the only solvent, with roughly 10 vol % acetic acid — a composition mimicking ommercial vinegar — and only 1 mol % of UO 2 (NO 3 ) 2 , a by-product of the nuclear fuel cycle. The mechanism underlying this transformation was examined in detail through luminescence measurements, EPR spectroscopy, isotope-labelling experiments, and speciation studies. DFT calculations show that the process involves an unstable intermediate, U V O 2 + -AcOH template, which is prompt to disproportionation into inactive U IV and appears to be responsible for the low TON, which is reported. However, the speciation studies also suggest that the equatorial environment of UO 2 2+ would stabilize this UV intermediate and therefore influence the CH 4 production as well as decreasing the potential additional competitive paths, leading to greater selectivity.
items.authors: Eachann Assendjee, Thayalan Rajeshkumar, Lhoussain Khrouz, Yoann Fréroux, Cyrille Monnereau, Olivier Maury

items.title: Trapacycle: A Chiral Rhombic Macrocycle
items.abstract: The development of a new class of macrocycles is a primary issue in supramolecular chemistry. We here report the synthesis, spectroscopic properties, and host-guest functions of chiral, rhombus-shaped macrocyclic oligoimides 1, denoted as trapacycles. Trapacycle (+)-1 could be readily synthesized by the condensation of 9,10-dihydro-9,10-ethanoanthracenebased tetracarboxylic dianhydride 2 with (1S,2S)-cyclohexane-1,2-diamine D-tartrate. Its enantiomer (–)-1 could be analogously accessed from 2 and (1R,2R)-cyclohexane-1,2-diamine L-tartrate. The solid-state crystalline structures of 1 showed intrinsic rhombic shape pores and extrinsic pores. These pores were found to accommodate guest solvent molecules. Furthermore, 1 adsorbed iodine vapor in the solid state and accommodated naphthalenes in organic solvents.
items.authors: Sei Murayama, Hiroshi Naka
items.title_zh: Trapacycle：一种手性菱形大环化合物
items.summary_zh: 大环化合物的新类群的开发是超分子化学中的一个主要问题。本文报道了手性菱形大环寡酰亚胺1（称为trapacycles）的合成、光谱特性及其宿主-客体功能。Trapacycle (+)-1可通过9,10-二氢-9,10-乙烯基蒽基四羧酸二酸酐2与(1S,2S)-环己烷-1,2-二胺D-酒石酸盐的缩合反应合成。其对映体(–)-1则可通过类似方法从2和(1R,2R)-环己烷-1,2-二胺L-酒石酸盐获得。1的固态晶体结构显示出内在的菱形孔和外在孔，这些孔能够容纳客体溶剂分子。此外，1在固态下吸附碘蒸气，并在有机溶剂中容纳萘分子。
items.l1_lead: 本文合成了一种新型手性菱形大环化合物trapacycle，展示了其独特的结构特征及在宿主-客体功能中的应用潜力。
items.l2_summary:
在超分子化学领域，大环化合物的新类群的开发一直是一个重要的研究方向。本文介绍了一种新型手性菱形大环化合物，称为trapacycle（手性菱形大环寡酰亚胺1），并详细探讨了其合成方法、光谱特性及宿主-客体功能。trapacycle (+)-1的合成是通过9,10-二氢-9,10-乙烯基蒽基四羧酸二酸酐2与(1S,2S)-环己烷-1,2-二胺D-酒石酸盐的缩合反应实现的，而其对映体(–)-1则是通过类似的方法，从2和(1R,2R)-环己烷-1,2-二胺L-酒石酸盐获得。

trapacycle的固态晶体结构分析显示，该化合物具有内在的菱形孔和外在孔，这些孔能够有效地容纳客体溶剂分子。具体而言，trapacycle在固态下能够吸附碘蒸气，并在有机溶剂中容纳萘分子，这表明其在宿主-客体相互作用方面具有良好的性能。这些特性使得trapacycle在超分子化学和材料科学领域具有潜在的应用价值。通过对trapacycle的研究，本文为大环化合物的设计和合成提供了新的思路，推动了相关领域的发展。

items.title: Fluorinated Olefins as Traceless Linchpins for Modular Non-Directed C–H Alkenylation Reactions
items.abstract: Palladium-catalyzed non-directed C–H olefination provides an attractive strategy for the direct functionalization of simple arenes, yet its modularity is typically limited by the need for prefunctionalized olefin coupling partners. Here, we report an unconventional tracelesslinchpin strategy using bromo-difluoromethyl-substituted olefins for the modular synthesis of cinnamic acid esters. In contrast to the expected formation of fluorinated alkenes, the fluorinated olefin undergoes palladium-catalyzed non-directed C–H functionalization followed by defluorinative transformation in the presence of alcohols, furnishing the corresponding cinnamic acid esters. The method tolerates a broad range of fluorinated and non-fluorinated alcohols as well as structurally diverse arenes, providing access to products in generally good to excellent yields and useful regioselectivities. The modular nature of the transformation further enables the late-stage functionalization of pharmaceutically relevant molecules and the direct synthesis of drug–drug and drug–natural product conjugates. Mechanistic studies support an initial C–H functionalization with the fluorinated olefin, followed by subsequent conversion of the resulting intermediate into the corresponding cinnamic acid esters.
items.authors: Namrata Kotwal, Deepak Sharma, Anirban Mandal, Claire Empel

items.title: Reconciliation Through Integration: A Source-Level Bayesian Framework for Developing Measurement-Integrated Methane Inventories
items.abstract: Bottom-up (BU) inventories and top-down (TD) aerial measurements at midstream natural gas facilities frequently diverge, and this discrepancy remains a central challenge for methane accounting in the sector. Previous approaches typically reconcile this divergence by treating BU and TD data as independent estimates of a single true quantity to be adjusted toward agreement, rather than as evidence that each capture only part of a more complex underlying system. This complexity arises from methane emissions being strongly governed by equipment operational state and therefore instantaneous aerial “snapshots” translate poorly to annual inventories. We argue instead that BU and TD are complementary sources of evidence that should be integrated. We present a source-level Bayesian framework that constructs BU prior distributions for each emission source category and updates them with attributed aerial detections through an empirical data-augmentation procedure. The resulting posterior distributions were propagated through unit-level activity data and source-specific information via Monte Carlo simulation to produce annual estimates. Across 64 compressor stations, measurement-integrated annual estimates were 84% higher than the BU inventory, a difference driven almost entirely by compressor vents (rod packing and seal vents), and leakage through blowdown and isolation valves, which together accounted for 90% of the asset-level revision. The revision was heterogeneous across stations and source categories, emphasizing the importance of source-level, station-specific integration when developing an emissions inventory.
items.authors: Abdulahi Raji, Caitlin Barndt, Joshua Blaine, Scott Peters, Arvind P. Ravikumar

items.title: Free Amino Acids Decrease Beer Foam Stability
items.abstract: Basic amino acids have previously been reported to impair beer foam adhesion and lacing. This study examined whether adverse effects of free amino acids on beer foam stability extend to non-basic amino acids. Concentration ranges (ΔC = Cmax − Cmin) were determined for individual amino acids in more than 200 production lots of a single Japanese pilsner brand collected across factories in 2016. Individual amino acids were added to fresh commercial beer at two supplementation levels, 2ΔC and 4ΔC, and foam stability was evaluated using the NIBEM-30 method. Compared with matched controls, lysine and histidine lowered NIBEM values at both supplementation levels, while arginine lowered the value at the higher level. A mixture of these basic amino acids also lowered NIBEM values. Crucially, reductions were also observed following supplementation with non-basic amino acids, including glutamine, glycine, proline, and γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA). In a separate evaluation, increasing laboratory ambient temperature from 20 to 27 °C shortened the measured collapse time by 19 s at a constant beer temperature of 20 °C, emphasizing the importance of controlling the measurement environment. These findings indicate that amino acids capable of reducing beer foam stability are not confined to basic amino acids: certain non-basic amino acids can also reduce foam stability under the tested supplementation conditions. 日本語要旨：塩基性アミノ酸は、ビールの泡の付着性およびレーシングを損なうことが従来報告されている。本研究では、遊離ア ミノ酸によるビールの泡安定性への悪影響が、非塩基性アミノ酸にも認められるかを検討した。2016年に複数の工場から収集した、 日本の単一ピルスナーブランドの200ロットを超える製品を対象として、各アミノ酸の濃度範囲（ΔC＝最高濃度－最低濃度）を求め た。新鮮な市販ビールに各アミノ酸を2ΔCおよび4ΔCの2水準で添加し、NIBEM-30法により泡安定性を評価した。対応する対照と比 較して、リシンとヒスチジンは両添加水準でNIBEM値を低下させ、アルギニンは高い添加水準で低下させた。これらの塩基性アミ ノ酸の混合物もNIBEM値を低下させた。特に、グルタミン、グリシン、プロリン、γ-アミノ酪酸（GABA）などの非塩基性アミノ酸 の添加でも、NIBEM値の低下が観察された。別途行った評価では、ビール温度を20 °Cに一定に保った状態で実験室の室温を20 °Cか ら27 °Cに上げると、測定された泡の崩壊時間が19秒短縮し、測定環境を管理する重要性が示された。これらの結果は、ビールの泡 安定性を低下させうるアミノ酸が塩基性アミノ酸に限られず、今回の添加条件では、一部の非塩基性アミノ酸も泡安定性を低下さ せうることを示している。
items.authors: Toru KISHIMOTO

items.title: Towards an Accurate Atomistic Description of Procaine Crystals: Force Field Development and MD Simulation of Solid-to-Liquid Phase Transitions
items.abstract: Rational design of crystalline materials is crucial for material science and pharmaceutical development, requiring molecular modeling as a powerful complementary tool. This study employs molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the thermal stability, structural evolution, and melting mechanisms of crystalline procaine base across a temperature range of 23 to 373 K. To evaluate potential finite-size and boundary effects, two distinct computational setups were considered: a bulk crystal model under periodic boundary conditions (System I, 600 molecules) and an isolated nanocrystal in vacuum (System II, 1188 molecules). Both systems demonstrate well-preserved long-range positional ordering from 23 to 313 K, followed by the appearance of a plastic crystalline state with enhanced rotational freedom between 323 and 333 K. At 343 K, a heterogeneous, surface-initiated phase transition to an isotropic melt occurs, which closely matches the experimental melting point of procaine free-base of 334-337 K. MD analysis reveals remarkably slow melting kinetics at 333-343 K, where a crystalline core persists for over 300 ns before complete melting at 500 ns. We found that the thermal breakdown of the crystal lattice strongly correlates with a breakage of the intermolecular hydrogen-bonding 3D network between procaine molecules. Radial distribution function (RDF) analysis shows a sharp shift in the primary amino nitrogen correlations (N10···N10) towards short-distances upon melting, whereas short-range hydrogen-bond N10···O9 distances remain spatially invariant in the liquid phase. Mean square displacement (MSD) of procaine molecules demonstrates a dramatic transition from restricted lattice vibrations below 333 K to active fluid diffusion above 343 K. These findings are accompanied by rotational autocorrelation functions transition from long-time orientational persistence in the solid state (23-333 K) to rapid exponential relaxation in the melt (343-373 K). Finally, unconstrained melting of System II produces a spherical nanodroplet driven by surface tension minimization, confirming that the performance of the developed OPLS-AA FF model.
items.authors: Viktoriia O. Chukhlib, Viktor V. Tokariev, Alexander Kyrychenko
items.title_zh: 精确描述普鲁卡因晶体的原子级模型：力场开发与相变MD模拟
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对普鲁卡因晶体的热稳定性、结构演变和熔化机制进行分子动力学（MD）模拟，温度范围为23至373 K。考虑到有限尺寸和边界效应，采用了两种计算模型：周期性边界条件下的体晶体模型（系统I，600个分子）和真空中的孤立纳米晶体（系统II，1188个分子）。结果显示，两种系统在23至313 K范围内保持良好的长程位置有序性，323至333 K间出现增强旋转自由度的塑性晶态。在343 K时，发生表面引发的异质相变，形成各向同性熔体，与普鲁卡因游离碱的实验熔点334-337 K相符。分析表明，在333-343 K间熔化动力学极为缓慢，晶体核心在300 ns内持续存在，500 ns时完全熔化。研究发现晶格的热崩溃与普鲁卡因分子间氢键三维网络的断裂密切相关。
items.l1_lead: 本研究通过分子动力学模拟揭示了普鲁卡因晶体在不同温度下的热稳定性和熔化机制，发现其熔化过程与氢键网络的断裂密切相关。
items.l2_summary:
本研究通过分子动力学（MD）模拟，深入探讨了普鲁卡因晶体的热稳定性、结构演变及熔化机制，温度范围覆盖23至373 K。为考虑有限尺寸和边界效应，研究采用了两种计算模型：体晶体模型（系统I，600个分子）和真空中的孤立纳米晶体（系统II，1188个分子）。结果表明，在23至313 K的温度范围内，两种系统均保持良好的长程位置有序性，而在323至333 K之间，系统则出现了增强旋转自由度的塑性晶态。

在343 K时，研究观察到表面引发的异质相变，形成各向同性熔体，这一现象与普鲁卡因游离碱的实验熔点334-337 K相吻合。分析结果显示，在333至343 K之间，熔化动力学过程极为缓慢，晶体核心在300 ns内持续存在，直到500 ns时才完全熔化。研究进一步揭示，晶格的热崩溃与普鲁卡因分子间氢键三维网络的断裂密切相关，这一发现为理解普鲁卡因晶体的熔化机制提供了重要的理论基础。

综上所述，本研究不仅为普鲁卡因晶体的热稳定性和相变行为提供了详实的分子动力学模拟数据，也为相关药物的物理化学性质研究奠定了基础。

items.title: Polymorphous Structural Landscapes Drive Broadband Optical Response in Water-Stable Mixed-Halide Antiperovskites
items.abstract: Silver chalcohalide antiperovskites have emerged as low-toxicity semiconductors with strong near-infrared absorption, although their unusual composition-dependent optical properties, including inverse bandgap bowing, remain poorly understood. Here, Ag3SI1-xBrx solid solutions were synthesized by a solvent-free mechanochemical route and investigated by structural and optical characterization, ultrafast spectroscopy, and first-principles calculations. While all compositions retain an average cubic Pm-3m structure and exhibit a Vegard-like lattice contraction with increasing Br content, strongly nonlinear optical behavior and multiple absorption onsets are observed. First principles calculations reveal that these alloys are more appropriately described by an ensemble of electronically distinct low-energy configurations arising from an underlying polymorphous energy landscape. This configurational diversity redistributes band-edge spectral weight, enables quasi-direct transitions at Γ, and provides a microscopic explanation for the broadband absorption and anomalous bandgap evolution. Transient absorption spectroscopy further supports the presence of different compositiondependent electronic environments and reveals prolonged carrier lifetimes for mixed-halides, consistent with alloy-disorder-induced localization. From an applicative perspective, these materials show remarkable water stability and efficient photothermal energy conversion enabling their use in a proof-of-concept solar water evaporation setup. These findings establish Ag3SI1-xBrx antiperovskites as water-stable, low-toxicity, broadband-absorbing materials and demonstrate the importance of polymorphous local structure in governing their optical response.
items.authors: Sahiba Bano, Ghita Khatiri, Mitisha Jain, Prince Sharma, Saurabh Saini, Byeongchan Lee

items.title: Single-Ion Hydration Through the Lens of Data-Driven Many-Body Potentials
items.abstract: Single-ion hydration provides a stringent test of molecular models because local ionwater interactions, collective polarization, nuclear quantum effects, and long-range electrostatics all contribute to experimentally measurable structure, spectra, and thermodynamics. Here we discuss how data-driven many-body potentials, in particular MB-pol for water and MB-nrg for hydrated ions, provide a physically transparent route from correlated electronic structure data to predictive simulations of ion hydration from clusters to bulk water and aqueous interfaces. We emphasize how this framework transforms single-ion hydration from a parameterization problem into a hierarchy of many-body observables, and we outline opportunities for connecting simulations directly with interfacial spectroscopy, hydration free energies, and complex electrolyte environments.
items.authors: Francesco Paesani, Suman Saha, Richa Rashmi, Henry Agnew, Xuanyu Zhu, Olivia Zhou

items.title: Red TADF Pyridoquinoxaline-Annulated Curved Nitrogen-Doped PAHs and their use in OLEDs
items.abstract: Curved nitrogen-doped polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons offer a rigid and nonplanar framework for investigating how donor identity regulates the balance between locally excited and charge-transfer states in thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) emitters. Here, a pyrido[2,3b]quinoxaline unit was integrated into a dibenzo[b,f]azepine-based polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon scaffold and functionalized with one of 3,6-di- tert -butylcarbazole ( TBCzPyN-PAH ), diphenylamine ( DPAPyN-PAH ), 9,9-dimethyl-9,10-dihydroacridine ( DMAcPyN-PAH ), or phenoxazine ( PXZPyN-PAH ) donor moieties. The resulting series provides a common acceptor framework in which the electronic and conformational properties of the peripheral donor affect the 2 energies of the excited states. Donor substitution tunes the emission maximum in toluene from 528 to 697 nm. In 2 wt% doped films in CBP, these compounds emit from 519 to 622 nm with PLQY of up to 58%. Temperature-dependent time-resolved photoluminescence confirms TADF for all investigated compounds except for the DPA derivative. Across the TADF-active series, the singlet–triplet energy gap, Δ E ST , decreases from 0.22 to 0.03 eV and the delayed fluorescence lifetime shortens from 8.5 ms to 29 μs. Vacuum-deposited OLEDs with TBCzPyN-PAH showed EQE max , of 21.6% at an electroluminescence maximum of 538 nm, whereas the device with PXZPyN-PAH emitted at 606 nm and showed a lower EQE max of 7.2% but with a milder efficiency roll-off.
items.authors: Jakub Wagner, Eglė Tankelevičiūtė, Haoyang Li, Tomas Matulaitis, Maja Morawiak, Maciej Jelecki

items.title: Explicit and Parallelised Octupole and Hexadecapole Moment Interactions in Flexible Smooth Particle Mesh Ewald
items.abstract: Long-range electrostatic interactions have long been known to be important in the accurate simulation of biomolecular systems and molecular crystals. Despite this fact, these interactions are absent in many machine learning force fields aiming to improve upon classical potentials. In the worst cases, this omission can lead to serious discrepancies with experimental results. FFLUX is a machine learning force field that predicts atomic energies and multipole moments up to the hexadecapole moment on-the-fly during molecular dynamics simulations. The predicted multipole moments are fed into an adapted smooth particle mesh Ewald algorithm allowing long-range electrostatic interactions to be calculated. Here we present refactoring of the Ewald routines and a new implementation of routines handling interactions involving octupole and hexadecapole moments. The new implementation leads to a speed-up of up to 10.5 times in serial compared to our previous implementation. Additionally, a hybrid parallelisation scheme using a combination of Message Passing Interface and OpenMP is made available to these high-electrostatic-rank calculations. This parallelisation offers speed-ups of up to two orders of magnitude, improving the feasibility of bulk simulations with high-rank electrostatic interactions using FFLUX force fields.
items.authors: Matthew L. Brown, Michael K. Bane, Paul L. A. Popelier, Paul L.A. Popelier

items.title: A spectral reset law explains and predicts periodic recurrence in the elements
items.abstract: The recurrence of chemical properties is the defining feature of the periodic system, yet it is conventionally explained only indirectly, through inferred electron configurations and heuristic filling rules rather than being directly derived from atomic observables. Building on an empirical spectral framework in which elements occupy a bounded spectral space defined by two measured frequencies, the K-edge frequency (𝜈 max ) and the first ionization frequency (𝜈 ion ), we show that recurrence arises from simple quantitative constraints operating directly on these observables. As 𝜈 max increases across the elemental sequence, 𝜈 ion rises toward the upper boundary of the spectral space. At this limiting condition, a spectral mode bifurcates and 𝜈 ion undergoes a sharp reset toward a nearly invariant baseline, cancelling the accumulated rise to within 1%. Repetition of this rise–split–reset structure partitions spectral space into successive bounded intervals that emerge as periods, with lower and upper edges corresponding to elements conventionally classified as Groups 1 and 18, respectively. The rise–split–reset structure yields the recurrence 𝜈 ion (𝑛 + 1) = 𝜈 ion (𝑛) + Δ𝜈 ion (rise) − Δ𝜈 ion (reset) , with |Δ𝜈 ion | = 𝐴𝜈 𝑚𝑎𝑥 𝑏 , so that successive period anchors recur at the same relative position in spectral space. Across the four experimental period boundaries, reset magnitude scales linearly with the spectral splitting amplitude (𝑅 2 = 0.962), empirically linking the recurrence to the mode differentiation that establishes the periods. Seeded with a single measured value (lithium), the recursion regenerates the experimental G1 and G18 period anchors with a median error of 1.4%, and extrapolates beyond the known table to hypothetical periods 8 and 9, including element 119 at 𝜈 ion = (1.12 ± 0.33) × 10 15 s −1 (4.6 ± 1.4 eV). These results establish periodic recurrence as a quantitative, generative spectral structure in measurement space and show that ionization frequencies are not independent quantities, but are determined sequentially from a single seed and a pair of spectral scaling power laws with only two measured observables.
items.authors: Abdennour Abbas

items.title: Nano-Focusing of Fiber-Guided Vortex Beam using Plasmonic Nanoantennas
items.abstract: Optical vortex beams carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) and cylindrical vector beams (CVBs) enable unique functionalities in optical communication, sensing, and chiral light-matter interactions. However, their use at the nanoscale is hindered by a spatial mismatch between the micron-scale beam and nanoscale targets, limiting light-matter coupling. In this study, we investigate a fiber-integrated plasmonic platform that confines fiber-guided vortex modes to subwavelength dimensions using a radially symmetric gold nanorod array on a polarization-maintaining ring-core vortex fiber facet. Full-vectorial finite-element simulations examine the coupling of radially polarized (TM 01 ), azimuthally polarized (TE 01 ), and circularly polarized (CP) OAM modes to the nanostructure array. The simulations predict symmetry-selective field enhancement and confinement to a ~300 nm central region (spatial confinement factor ~13), while preserving the polarization state, and helical phase of the OAM beam. The TM 01 mode yields the strongest enhancement through symmetry matching with the radial array, the CP-OAM modes show comparable enhancement and helicity-independent confinement, and the TE 01 mode couples weakly. Experimentally, we fabricate the nanostructure array on the fiber facet and characterize the transmitted modes in the far-field, where polarization-projection and coaxial interference measurements verify stable far-field propagation with nominal circular-polarization and topological charge magnitude | l |. These results establish a compact, scalable platform for predicted subwavelength confinement of structured light toward nanoscale light-matter interaction and chiral sensing.
items.authors: Rohil Kayastha, Wei Zhang, Blake Birmingham, Aaron P. Greenberg, Zhi Gao, Rafael Quintero-Torres

items.title: Information Thresholds in Adaptive Quantum Control of Nonadiabatic Molecular Dynamics:
items.abstract: Ultrafast photochemical reactions can undergo strongly nonadiabatic dynamics near conical intersections, where electronic and nuclear degrees of freedom become coupled and conventional descriptions based on electronic populations alone may become insufficient for control. This paper proposes an information-aware framework for adaptive quantum control in which the information supplied to a controller is treated as an explicit experimental variable. Using a benchmark four-mode linear vibronic-coupling model of pyrazine, the proposed computational study compares control performance across a hierarchy of information levels, from final reaction outcomes and electronic populations to nuclear observables, electronic coherences, and complete quantum-state information. The central hypothesis is that the minimum information required to achieve a specified control fidelity depends on proximity to the nonadiabatic branching region. This is formalized through an information-threshold function relating control fidelity to conical-intersection proximity, with particular emphasis on the marginal benefit of coherence and nuclear information. The manuscript provides a reproducible computational protocol, including pulse parameterization, optimization, information ablation, control objectives, validation criteria, and falsification tests. No simulations or new numerical calculations are reported; the numerical predictions are explicitly identified as hypotheses requiring future computational testing.
items.authors: Oluwatoni Sobande, Oluwatoni. E Sobande

items.title: SimSJSAlert: A Similarity-Augmented Multi-View Learning Framework with Scaffold Alerts for Drug-Induced Stevens-Johnson Syndrome Risk Assessment
items.abstract: Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS) is a rare, life-threatening adverse drug reaction for which early identification of high-risk drugs remains challenging. In this study, we developed an explainable quantitative structure-toxicity relationship (QSTR) framework for SJS prediction using a multi-view learning framework with 21 molecular representations, including molecular descriptors, fingerprints, transformer-based embeddings, and a molecular similarity representation. Model development and evaluation were designed in accordance with the OECD principles for QSAR validation, incorporating scaffold-aware validation, external evaluation on pharmacovigilance negative-signal compounds, and structural interpretation by integrating SHAP with Bemis-Murcko scaffold enrichment analysis. The proposed framework achieved robust sensitivity and specificity, with molecular similarity consistently improving the identification of SJS-associated compounds. Furthermore, a consensus prediction and scaffold-based prioritization strategy identified several high-risk drugs from the 1 external negative-signal dataset, including cefprozil, tetracycline, and omadacycline, highlighting their potential association with SJS and warranting further pharmacovigilance and experimental investigation. To facilitate practical application, this was deployed as a freely accessible web server, SimSJSAlert (https: //sim-sjs-alert.streamlit.app/), enabling rapid drug-induced SJS risk assessment. The proposed framework combines predictive performance, interpretability, and accessibility to support early SJS risk assessment, pharmacovigilance signal prioritization, and safer drug development.
items.authors: Huynh Anh Duy, Sastiya Kampaengsri, Supreeya Paiboon, Tarapong Srisongkram
items.title_zh: SimSJSAlert：用于药物诱导Stevens-Johnson综合征风险评估的多视角学习框架
items.summary_zh: Stevens-Johnson综合征（SJS）是一种罕见且危及生命的药物不良反应，早期识别高风险药物仍然具有挑战性。本研究开发了一种可解释的定量结构-毒性关系（QSTR）框架，用于SJS预测，采用了包含21种分子表征的多视角学习框架，包括分子描述符、指纹、基于变换器的嵌入和分子相似性表征。模型开发和评估遵循OECD QSAR验证原则，结合了骨架意识验证、对药物监测负信号化合物的外部评估，以及通过将SHAP与Bemis-Murcko骨架富集分析相结合进行结构解释。该框架在灵敏度和特异性方面表现出色，分子相似性显著提高了SJS相关化合物的识别。此外，基于共识预测和骨架优先策略，从外部负信号数据集中识别出包括头孢噻肟、四环素和奥马西林在内的多种高风险药物，突显其与SJS的潜在关联，值得进一步的药物监测和实验研究。为便于实际应用，该框架已部署为免费访问的网络服务器SimSJSAlert。
items.l1_lead: 本研究开发的SimSJSAlert框架通过多视角学习显著提高了Stevens-Johnson综合征高风险药物的识别能力，为早期监测和研究提供了有效工具。
items.l2_summary:
Stevens-Johnson综合征（SJS）是一种罕见且危及生命的药物不良反应，早期识别高风险药物仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这一问题，本研究开发了一种可解释的定量结构-毒性关系（QSTR）框架，旨在预测SJS的风险。该框架采用了多视角学习方法，整合了21种分子表征，包括分子描述符、指纹、基于变换器的嵌入和分子相似性表征，从而提高了对SJS相关化合物的识别能力。

在模型开发和评估过程中，研究遵循了OECD QSAR验证原则，结合了骨架意识验证和对药物监测负信号化合物的外部评估。此外，研究还通过将SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）与Bemis-Murcko骨架富集分析相结合，进行了结构解释。这一框架在灵敏度和特异性方面表现出色，显著提高了SJS相关化合物的识别率。

通过基于共识预测和骨架优先策略，研究团队从外部负信号数据集中识别出多种高风险药物，包括头孢噻肟、四环素和奥马西林，这些药物与SJS的潜在关联值得进一步的药物监测和实验研究。为便于实际应用，该框架已被部署为免费访问的网络服务器SimSJSAlert，旨在为药物安全性评估提供便利。整体而言，该研究为SJS的风险评估提供了一种新的工具，具有重要的临床应用价值。

items.title: Full-scale Hazardous Waste Incineration of PFAS in Fluorotelomer-Based Aqueous Film-Forming Foam
items.abstract: In the absence of full-scale incineration studies into the impacts of temperature on thermal destruction of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), globally evolving regulatory guidelines have been inconsistent. In this study, we incinerated a fluorotelomerization-based aqueous film-forming foam (AFFF) concentrate at different temperatures and feed rates of up to 1500 kg/h in one of the largest hazardous waste incinerators in the world. At secondary combustion chamber temperatures as low as 950 °C and 2 seconds gas residence time, the destruction and removal efficiency for the main AFFF component 6:2 fluorotelomer sulfonamide alkylbetaine (6:2 FTAB, a.k.a. Capstone B) exceeded 99.999999% at the highest AFFF feed rate. Non-polar volatile fluorinated compounds targeted by Other Test Method 50 (OTM-50) were below method detection limits, while PFAS concentrations in ashes and scrubber waters were practically indistinguishable from baseline conditions when no fluorine-containing waste was incinerated. PFAS stack emissions into the atmosphere during AFFF treatment were substantially lower than volatile PFAS emissions from a typical landfill. Quantum chemical modeling suggested that a similar treatment efficiency may be expected for perfluorooctane sulfonic acid (PFOS)-based electrochemical fluorination foams. The findings of our study suggest that hazardous waste incineration may be effective at temperatures well below the 1100 °C required by some current regulations, minimizing fuel consumption, equipment wear, and undesirable side reactions during thermal PFAS destruction.
items.authors: Jens Blotevogel, Wenchao Lu, Anthony K. Rappé, Olaf Holm, Marco Gross, Peter Leube
items.title_zh: 全规模焚烧氟化物泡沫中的PFAS研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对氟化聚合物基水性膜形成泡沫（AFFF）浓缩液，探讨了温度对全规模焚烧中全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）热解的影响。在全球最大危险废物焚烧炉之一中，我们在不同温度和最高1500 kg/h的进料速率下进行了焚烧。结果显示，在950°C的二次燃烧室温度和2秒的气体停留时间下，主要成分6:2氟聚合物磺酰胺烷基甜菜碱（6:2 FTAB）的去除效率超过99.999999%。根据其他测试方法50（OTM-50），非极性挥发性氟化合物的浓度低于检测限，而焚烧后灰烬和洗涤水中的PFAS浓度与未焚烧氟含废物的基线条件几乎无差别。AFFF处理过程中PFAS的排放显著低于典型垃圾填埋场的挥发性PFAS排放。量子化学模型表明，类似的处理效率也可能适用于基于全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）的电化学氟化泡沫。研究结果表明，危险废物焚烧可能是一种有效的PFAS处理方法。
items.l1_lead: 本研究表明，在高温焚烧条件下，氟化物泡沫中的PFAS可被有效去除，焚烧处理的PFAS排放显著低于垃圾填埋场。
items.l2_summary: 本研究针对氟化聚合物基水性膜形成泡沫（AFFF）浓缩液，探讨了温度对全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）在全规模焚烧过程中的热解影响。研究在全球最大危险废物焚烧炉之一进行，焚烧条件包括不同温度和最高1500 kg/h的进料速率。结果表明，在950°C的二次燃烧室温度和2秒的气体停留时间下，主要成分6:2氟聚合物磺酰胺烷基甜菜碱（6:2 FTAB）的去除效率超过99.999999%。此外，根据其他测试方法50（OTM-50），焚烧后非极性挥发性氟化合物的浓度低于检测限，且焚烧后灰烬和洗涤水中的PFAS浓度与未焚烧氟含废物的基线条件几乎无差别。这表明，AFFF处理过程中PFAS的排放显著低于典型垃圾填埋场的挥发性PFAS排放。量子化学模型的分析进一步表明，类似的处理效率也可能适用于基于全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）的电化学氟化泡沫。综上所述，研究结果表明，危险废物焚烧可能是一种有效的PFAS处理方法，为氟化物泡沫的安全处置提供了重要的科学依据。

items.title: Dynamic Oxygen-Vacancy Redistribution Regulates the Structural Evolution and Stability of Supported Au Nanoparticles
items.abstract: Supported metal nanoparticles (NPs) on reducible oxides are widely employed as heterogeneous catalysts, where the metal-support interaction plays a pivotal role in determining catalytic activity, stability, and resistance to sintering. Oxygen vacancies (Ovs) in cerium oxide (CeO2-x) are known to modify the electronic and structural properties of the support; however, how their redistribution regulates the structural evolution and stability of supported metal nanoparticles at the atomic scale remains poorly understood. Here, by combining molecular dynamics simulations, density functional theory calculations, and experimental observations, we show that Ovs are preferentially distributed in the second oxygen layer rather than the outermost surface and undergo temperature-dependent redistribution. Increasing Ov concentration induces a pronounced size-dependent structural reconstruction of supported Au NPs, with smaller NPs exhibiting greater flattening associated with enhanced interfacial electron transfer. Meanwhile, vacancy-enhanced metal-support interactions restrict NP mobility and improve resistance to sintering. Under H2O-containing conditions, water dissociation further stabilizes the NPs through surface H species while triggering extensive oxygen redistribution within the CeO2-x lattice. The second oxygen layer accommodates substantial changes in oxygen population while preserving a relatively stable electronic environment, highlighting its role as a dynamic oxygen reservoir. These results establish a unified picture in which oxygen-vacancy dynamics couple support restructuring with the morphology and mobility of supported Au NPs, offering an atomic-scale basis for designing sintering-resistant metal/oxide catalysts.
items.authors: Siyuan Yang, Zhongliang Cao, Weiwei Zhang, Langli Luo, Xing Chen

items.title: BondNet: Noise-Robust Molecular Bond Perception from 3D Coordinates with Explicit Hydrogen Context
items.abstract: Recovering molecular graphs from atomic identities and 3D coordinates is a key step in coordinate-first molecular modelling and generation. We present Bond-Net, a two-stage framework in which a PaiNN model first predicts connectivity on a distance-derived candidate graph and a topology-aware network then classifies heavy–heavy bond types. Explicit hydrogens participate in message passing as local valence context but are excluded from bond-type supervision and scoring. On a fixed 26,940-molecule GEOM-DRUGS validation cohort, the near-clean model achieves pipeline macro-F1 = 0.9994 and correctly types every reference heavy–heavy bond in 99.4% of molecules. A historical ablation shows that removing hydrogen context reduces macro-F1 by 6.7 percentage points and the exact-type rate to 19.7%. With Gaussian coordinate-noise augmentation and candidate graphs rebuilt from the perturbed coordinates, BondNet retains pipeline macro-F1 = 0.9859 and a true-bond exact-type rate of 87.7% at σ = 0.1 Å; its stricter HH-graph exact match is 83.0% because extra predicted bonds are also penalized. BondNet’s pipeline macro-F1 exceeds RDKit DetermineBonds at every tested noise level on the common denominator. Residual strict-label disagreements are concentrated in resonance-ambiguous N–O and carboxyl motifs. An exact-molecule-leakage-controlled diversity study further shows that a curated multi-source set of 80,000 molecules transfers better than both a same-size random GEOM subset and a 3.4× larger single-source set. 1 Scientific Contribution. BondNet isolates geometric connectivity from topology-aware bond typing and quantifies how explicit-hydrogen context and noise augmentation affect robust graph recovery. The study also provides atom-pair-matched baselines, explicitly reports tool failures, and introduces an exact-molecule-leakage-controlled comparison of training-set diversity and scale.
items.authors: Xiaochen Zhang, Hui Zeng, Xiao-Chen Zhang
items.title_zh: BondNet：基于3D坐标的抗噪声分子键感知
items.summary_zh: 从原子身份和3D坐标恢复分子图是坐标优先分子建模与生成的关键步骤。我们提出了BondNet，一个两阶段框架，其中PaiNN模型首先在基于距离的候选图上预测连接性，随后一个拓扑感知网络对重重键类型进行分类。显式氢参与信息传递作为局部价态上下文，但不参与键类型的监督和评分。在固定的26,940个分子GEOM-DRUGS验证集上，该模型实现了宏F1 = 0.9994，并在99.4%的分子中正确标记每个参考重重键。去除氢上下文会使宏F1降低6.7个百分点，精确类型率降至19.7%。在高斯坐标噪声增强和从扰动坐标重建的候选图下，BondNet保持宏F1 = 0.9859，真实键精确类型率为87.7%。BondNet的宏F1在所有测试噪声水平上均超过RDKit DetermineBonds。剩余的严格标签不一致主要集中在共振模糊的N–O和羧基结构中。
items.l1_lead: BondNet模型在抗噪声分子键感知中表现优异，宏F1达0.9859，显著优于传统方法，显示出其在分子建模中的潜力和鲁棒性。
items.l2_summary:
BondNet是一种基于3D坐标的抗噪声分子键感知模型，旨在从原子身份和三维坐标恢复分子图，这是坐标优先分子建模与生成的关键步骤。该模型采用了一个两阶段框架，首先由PaiNN模型在基于距离的候选图上预测分子之间的连接性，随后通过一个拓扑感知网络对重重键类型进行分类。在这一过程中，显式氢参与信息被用作局部价态上下文，但并不参与键类型的监督和评分。

在对固定的26,940个分子GEOM-DRUGS验证集进行测试时，BondNet实现了宏F1值为0.9994，且在99.4%的分子中正确标记了每个参考重重键。值得注意的是，去除氢上下文会导致宏F1值降低6.7个百分点，精确类型率降至19.7%。在引入高斯坐标噪声增强和从扰动坐标重建的候选图情况下，BondNet依然保持了宏F1值为0.9859，真实键精确类型率为87.7%。此外，BondNet在所有测试噪声水平上的宏F1值均超过了RDKit DetermineBonds模型。

剩余的严格标签不一致主要集中在共振模糊的N–O和羧基结构中，这表明在某些特定的化学环境下，模型的表现仍有提升空间。总体而言，BondNet展示了在复杂分子结构解析中的强大能力，尤其是在面对噪声和不确定性时，具有较高的稳定性和准确性。

items.title: All-Dielectric Metasurfaces in Fundamentals, Materials, and Emerging Applications
items.abstract: The field of optics is undergoing a transformative shift, pushed forward by the demand for miniaturized, lightweight, and highly functional components. Dielectric metasurfaces have emerged as a transformative platform in modern photonics, offering unprecedented control over the amplitude, phase, polarization, and frequency of light within an ultrathin, planar architecture. Unlike their metallic predecessors, all-dielectric metasurfaces exploit Mie resonances, bound states in the continuum, and multipolar interference to achieve low-loss, high-efficiency optical functionalities across the visible, near-infrared, and terahertz spectral ranges. This review covers the field systematically, starting with the common working principles of dielectric metasurfaces and the physical mechanisms that make them so versatile. We then discuss the most widely used material platforms, including their optical properties and practical trade-offs, followed by an overview of the fabrication techniques available today. We look at both traditional top-down methods, such as electron-beam lithography, and emerging high-throughput approaches like nanoimprint lithography and photochemical deposition. We also examine the design strategies and element geometries used to build optical functionality into these surfaces, from simple phase-shifting pillars to more complex resonant architectures. Finally, this review examines the broad range of applications these structures enable, from metalenses and holography to nonlinear optics, biosensing, and terahertz generation. By identifying the key open challenges in fabrication scalability, broadband operation, and active tunability, this review aims to serve both as a reference resource for specialists and as an entry point for researchers from adjacent disciplines, charting a clear roadmap for the next decade of flat-optics research.
items.authors: Rana Faryad Ali

items.title: Particle-Size Modulated MOFs for Fluorescent PFAS Sensing
items.abstract: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) require sensitive and accessible detection technologies to complement conventional laboratory-based analytical methods. Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) have emerged as promising fluorescence sensing platforms owing to their high surface areas, tunable pore environments, and versatile host-guest interactions. To date, efforts to improve MOF-based PFAS sensing have primarily focused on framework chemistry and pore engineering, while the role of particle size has remained largely unexplored. Here, we systematically investigate the influence of particle size on PFAS fluorescence sensing using NU-1000 as a model fluorescent MOF platform. A series of NU-1000 particles with sizes ranging from approximately 300 nm to 10 μm were synthesized while maintaining comparable crystallinity, porosity, morphology, and chemical composition. Fluorescence measurements revealed a pronounced particle-size dependence, with smaller particles exhibiting substantially enhanced responses toward perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA), perfluorooctane sulfonate (PFOS), and perfluorodecanoic acid (PFDA). Reducing the particle size from 2 μm to 300 nm lowered the limits of detection by approximately one-half, from 311.4 to 153.8 ppb for PFOA, from 282.0 to 145.3 ppb for PFOS, and from 615.4 to 269.4 ppb for PFDA. Mechanistic investigations showed that the observed size effect does not arise from differences in PFAS uptake. Instead, decreasing particle size increases the surface-to-volume ratio, resulting in a larger fraction of surface-accessible Zr6 adsorption sites and emissive TBAPy linkers that induces more efficient fluorescence signal generation. Consequently, PFAS adsorption events are converted into more substantial fluorescence responses despite comparable overall uptake. These findings identify particle size as a previously overlooked design parameter governing MOF-based fluorescence sensing and demonstrate that particle-size engineering offers a simple, effective, and broadly applicable strategy for enhancing sensing performance without altering framework chemistry or pore architecture.
items.authors: Minshu Chen, Wenjun Liu, Meng Du, Chujun Zhou, Tyler Maddox, Haoyuan Chen

items.title: The impact of configurational disorder on electronic structure of perovskite oxides
items.abstract: Compositionally complex perovskite oxides provide a broad design space for catalytic materials, yet the electronic consequences of configurational disorder remain insufficiently understood. Here, we use high-throughput density functional theory calculations to systematically investigate how B-site compositional complexity modifies the local electronic structure of perovskite oxides across single-metal, binary, and quinary compositions. We analyze electronic descriptors relevant to catalytic activity, including transition-metal eg occupancy, d-band center, oxygen p-band center, and metal–oxygen d–p overlap. Based on data mining of DFT electronic structures for 4,035 compositionally disordered perovskites, we demonstrate that configurational disorder gives rise to distributions of local electronic states originating from heterogeneous coordination environments. As a result, transition metals with electronic and oxidation-state flexibility can access substantially broadened electronic configurations. Compositional complexity also expands the range of accessible metal–oxygen interactions, although the magnitude and direction of this effect vary among constituent elements. These results establish a distribution-based description of electronic structure for compositionally disordered perovskites and highlight local-environment statistics as a key dimension for understanding and tuning the catalytic electronic structure of disordered oxides.
items.authors: Joonyoung Kee, Chuancheng Duan, Kevin Huang, Bin Ouyang

items.title: Three-photon Absorption Cross-Sections of Serotonin, Fluorescein, Rhodamine 6G, and Some Fluorescent Protein Chromophores
items.abstract: Interest in studying, enhancing the performance, and engineering of three-photon absorption (3PA) responsive molecular probes and bio-molecular systems, such as fluorescent proteins (FPs), has increased significantly over the last decade. 3PA has a deeper penetration than one-and two-photon absorption (1PA and 2PA, respectively). In particular, FPs can display 3PA within the deep tissue imaging window (1600-1870 nm). Experimentally, the 3PA ability (measured in terms of the 3PA cross-section, σ 3PA ) of a set of red fluorescent proteins (RFPs) has been reported before. On the other hand, just a handful of computational studies have determined the 3PA response and, in even fewer cases, determined the σ 3PA of selected FPs. By means of time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT) here we determine the σ 3PA of fluorescein, rhodamine 6G, serotonin, and a curated set of isolated FP chromophores for which their computationally determined 1PA and 2PA have been reported previously. The results from this investigation are in reasonably good agreement with their experimentally determined σ 3PA . We expect that in the future, our results for FP chromophores could be improved by the inclusion of effects of the protein, which are well-known to play important roles in determining the magnitude of 1PA, 2PA, and 3PA cross-sections. Finally, this investigation contributes to the understanding of multi-photon absorption photophysics of existent FPs and, furthermore, assists in the future engineering of new 3PA responsive FPs and FP chromophores.
items.authors: Maria Rossano-Tapia, Maryna Mondrusova, Ashton R. Henderson, Alex Brown
items.title_zh: 血清素、荧光素、罗丹明6G及荧光蛋白的三光子吸收截面研究
items.summary_zh: 近年来，三光子吸收（3PA）响应分子探针和生物分子系统（如荧光蛋白，FPs）的研究受到显著关注。3PA相较于单光子吸收（1PA）和双光子吸收（2PA）具有更深的穿透能力，特别是在深组织成像窗口（1600-1870 nm）内，FPs能够表现出3PA。本文采用时间相关密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）计算了荧光素、罗丹明6G、血清素及一组孤立FP色素的σ 3PA，之前已报道其1PA和2PA的计算结果。研究结果与实验测得的σ 3PA相符。未来，我们的FP色素结果可能通过考虑蛋白质效应得到改善，这些效应在确定1PA、2PA和3PA截面的大小中起重要作用。此研究有助于理解3PA的机制。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，荧光素、罗丹明6G和血清素等分子在深组织成像中表现出显著的三光子吸收能力，为理解其机制提供了重要依据。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，三光子吸收（3PA）作为一种新兴的分子探针和生物分子系统（如荧光蛋白，FPs）的研究方向，受到了广泛关注。与单光子吸收（1PA）和双光子吸收（2PA）相比，3PA具有更深的穿透能力，尤其在深组织成像窗口（1600-1870 nm）内，荧光蛋白能够表现出3PA特性。本文采用时间相关密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）对荧光素、罗丹明6G、血清素及一组孤立荧光蛋白色素的三光子吸收截面（σ 3PA）进行了计算，之前的研究已报道了它们的1PA和2PA的计算结果。研究表明，计算得到的σ 3PA与实验测得的结果相符，验证了所用理论模型的有效性。

此外，研究指出，未来的荧光蛋白色素结果可能通过考虑蛋白质效应得到进一步改善，这些效应在确定1PA、2PA和3PA截面的大小中起着重要作用。通过深入理解3PA的机制，研究为生物成像和分子探针的开发提供了新的视角和理论基础。这一研究不仅丰富了对三光子吸收现象的认识，也为相关领域的应用提供了重要的科学依据。

items.title: Octahedral Ligand Field as Magnetic Coordinate Frame in a Luminescent DyIII Single Molecule Magnet
items.abstract: The synthesis of lanthanide complexes with low coordination numbers is challenging because the large ionic radii of lanthanide ions generally promote the formation of highly coordinated species. Achieving lower coordination geometries requires introducing significant steric hindrance. We report two low coordinated, almost perfectly octahedral lanthanide complexes [LnIII(Ph3PO)4(HBS)2](OTf) (Ln = DyIII (1), YbIII (2) and NdIII (3), Ph3PO = triphenylphosphine oxide; HBS = 4-hydroxybenzenesulfonate). Their magnetic and temperature-dependent luminescent properties have been systematically investigated showing field induced Single Molecule Magnet behavior and f-f optical transitions. To rationalize these properties with Complete Active Space Spin Orbit Configuration Interaction calculations, we have extended our program to compute magnetic dipole oscillator strengths. We showed that the octahedral ligand field acts as the magnetic main axes, that small geometric distortions induce significant anisotropy and simulated luminescent and magnetic data in very good agreement with experiment.
items.authors: Christian F. Pachl, Sukhen Bala, Senthil K. Kuppusamy, Andreas Bischoff, Christopher E. Anson, Mario Ruben

items.title: From 4D to 2D: Efficient computation of the electron correlation energies of atoms in molecular systems
items.abstract: The accurate modeling of (bio)molecular systems remains a major challenge in computational chemistry. In recent years, machine learning potentials (MLPs) have emerged as a promising approach, combining the efficiency of classical force fields with near quantum-mechanical accuracy. Among these, the physics-informed MLP FFLUX employs the Interacting Quantum Atoms (IQA) energy partitioning scheme to decompose molecular energies into atomic contributions derived from quantum mechanics for machine learning. However, incorporating two-electron correlation energies into IQA, and consequently into FFLUX, is currently unfeasible for larger systems en masse, due to the steep computational scaling associated with the necessary storage and evaluation of the two-particle density matrix (2PDM). In this work, we introduce a proof-of-concept workflow that employs density fitting (DF) to compress the 2PDM into a two-index representation, thereby accelerating the IQA partitioning of two-electron correlation energies. By expressing traditionally four-centre electron repulsion integrals in terms of auxiliary basis functions, the DF approximation enables a size reduction of the 2PDM from O(N^4) to O(NDF^2), where N is the number of basis functions and NDF is the size of the auxiliary basis set. The method proposed here is demonstrated using coupled cluster singles and doubles densities. The resulting reduction in computational cost and memory requirements enables correlated IQA analyses for significantly larger systems than previously accessible. Thus, this development provides an important step towards incorporating explicit electron correlation and hence dispersion directly into FFLUX atomic ML models, thereby improving both their physical robustness and transferability. This advance will eliminate the need to artificially add empirical potentials, or a posteriori dispersion correction.
items.authors: Prasanta Bandyopadhyay, Gyula Samu, Mark A. Vincent, Olivia P. Aten, Peter R. Nagy, Paul L. A. Popelier

items.title: Bayesian reaction optimization with fixed MaleCNS features: performance, wiring controls, and reward–aversion diagnostics
items.abstract: Connectome-derived features provide one possible representation for reaction optimization, but their utility need not depend on measured neuronal pairing. We examine a Bayesian predictor using fixed mushroom-body features derived from MaleCNS connectivity, with observed prediction errors separated into engineered reward and aversion signals. An offline evaluator returns only selected recorded outcomes. We distinguish this predictor from earlier models that modify KC–MBON efficacy incrementally or reconstruct it from observed response ranks. The rank comparison changes both the learning head and acquisition rule. In the exploratory predictive-model evaluation, the mean best response over post-initial observations exceeded rank reconstruction by 0.486 percentage points on C–N coupling and 3.346 on Suzuki–Miyaura coupling. Differences from development-tuned Gaussian-process optimization were smaller, and their cluster-bootstrap intervals included zero. Native-versusrewired intervals also included zero. C–N responses were analytical yields; Suzuki responses were UV-area percentages. High/low response diagnostics separate input-dependent KC activity from outcome-dependent prediction updates: circuit activity remains fixed under an identical-cue outcome intervention. Reused datasets and input ensembles, and one rewired graph restrict inference. These results support evaluating anatomical representation, learning rule, search performance, and prediction accuracy separately; they establish neither statistical equivalence nor a unique advantage of native connectivity.
items.authors: Yuuya Nagata

items.title: Adaptive Voiding Enables Interfacial Morphological Control at Low Stack Pressure in Solid-State Batteries
items.abstract: Solid-state batteries with alkali metal anodes offer high energy density and improved safety, but their performance is hindered by void formation at the metal-solid electrolyte interface during metal stripping, leading to impedance rise and increased probability of dendrite formation upon plating. Here, we demonstrate that low concentrations ( 5 vol%) of potassium metal added to industrial-grade lithium metal creates a dispersed Na-K liquid phase that suppresses voiding and enables stable, high-capacity stripping at practical current densities and stack pressures below 1 MPa. We furthermore identify a low-frequency oscillatory impedance attributed to “adaptive voiding”—the cyclic expansion and contraction of interfacial voids arising from an interplay between void growth and lithium deformation. This behavior, revealed by cryo-PFIB imaging and electrochemical analysis, offers a diagnostic signature for evaluating interfacial stability. These findings highlight new opportunities for designing robust, high-capacity SSBs operable under realistic mechanical constraints by controlling dynamic interfacial morphologies.
items.authors: Vijay D Veeraraghavan, Chiung-Yuan Lo, Andrew B Li, Sriram S Murali, Cole D Fincher, Hancheng Zhao

items.title: A Simple and Green One-Pot Synthesis of 2-Arylbenzimidazoles from Alcohols Using MnO2/I2
items.abstract: A straightforward and green synthetic method has been developed to prepare functionalized 2-arylbenzimidazole derivatives from readily accessible starting materials (arylmethyl alcohols and o-phenylenediamines) via a two-step, one-pot reaction. In the first step, arylmethyl alcohols are oxidized using MnO2 (4-8 equiv.) under both solvent-free and toluene-mediated conditions. subsequently, the aromatic aldehyde undergoes a 10 mol% iodine-catalyzed condensation with o-phenylenediamine in toluene at 100 °C under open-air conditions, leading to the production of 2-substituted benzimidazoles. The one-pot direct conversion of benzyl alcohols to 2-arylbenzimidazoles proceeds efficiently, affording the desired benzofused imidazoles in good to excellent yields, up to 91%. The sustainable method exhibits broad substrate scope, tolerating a wide range of functional groups. Mechanistic studies support a plausible imine formation pathway, followed by cyclization and oxidative aromatization under open-air conditions. This work highlights the synthetic utility and potential of the developed green method for future applications in organic synthesis and medicinal chemistry.
items.authors: Savita Gat, Selvam Vasanth, Jayshree Nandkumar Solanke, Vasudevan Dhayalan, Rambabu Dandela
items.title_zh: 一种简单绿色的一锅法合成2-芳基苯并咪唑
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种简单绿色的合成方法，通过一步法从易得的起始材料（芳基甲醇和邻苯二胺）制备功能化的2-芳基苯并咪唑衍生物。第一步，使用MnO2（4-8当量）在无溶剂和甲苯介导条件下氧化芳基甲醇。随后，在开放空气条件下，芳香醛与邻苯二胺在100°C下进行10 mol%的碘催化缩合，生成2-取代苯并咪唑。该一锅法直接将苄醇转化为2-芳基苯并咪唑，反应效率高，产率可达91%。该可持续方法适用范围广，耐受多种功能团。机理研究支持了一个合理的亚胺形成路径，随后在开放空气条件下发生环化和氧化芳构化。此研究突显了所开发绿色方法在有机合成和药物化学中的潜在应用价值。
items.l1_lead: 本研究提出了一种高效绿色的一锅法合成2-芳基苯并咪唑，反应产率可达91%，展现了其在有机合成和药物化学中的广泛应用潜力。
items.l2_summary:
本研究提出了一种简单绿色的一锅法合成2-芳基苯并咪唑（2-arylbenzimidazole）衍生物，利用易得的起始材料芳基甲醇和邻苯二胺，通过一步法实现高效合成。研究中，首先采用二氧化锰（MnO2）作为氧化剂，在无溶剂和甲苯介导的条件下，对芳基甲醇进行氧化，使用4-8当量的MnO2。随后，在开放空气条件下，将芳香醛与邻苯二胺以10 mol%的碘催化剂进行缩合反应，反应温度设定为100°C，最终生成2-取代苯并咪唑。该方法的反应效率高，产率可达91%，显示出其优越的合成性能。

此外，该绿色合成方法具有广泛的适用性，能够耐受多种功能团的存在，进一步拓展了其应用范围。通过机理研究，支持了一个合理的亚胺（imine）形成路径，随后在开放空气条件下发生环化和氧化芳构化的过程。这一研究不仅展示了所开发方法在有机合成中的高效性和可持续性，还强调了其在药物化学领域的潜在应用价值，为未来的研究和工业应用提供了新的思路和方向。

items.title: Red TADF Pyridoquinoxaline-Annulated Curved Nitrogen-Doped PAHs and their use in OLEDs
items.abstract: Curved nitrogen-doped polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons offer a rigid and nonplanar framework for investigating how donor identity regulates the balance between locally excited and chargetransfer states in thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) emitters. Here, a pyrido[2,3b]quinoxaline unit was integrated into a dibenzo[b,f]azepine-based polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon scaffold and functionalized with one of 3,6-di-tert-butylcarbazole (TBCzPyN-PAH), diphenylamine (DPAPyN-PAH), 9,9-dimethyl-9,10-dihydroacridine (DMAcPyN-PAH), or phenoxazine (PXZPyN-PAH) donor moieties. The resulting series provides a common acceptor framework in which the electronic and conformational properties of the peripheral donor affect the 2 energies of the excited states. Donor substitution tunes the emission maximum in toluene from 528 to 697 nm. In 2 wt% doped films in CBP, these compounds emit from 519 to 622 nm with PLQY of up to 58%. Temperature-dependent time-resolved photoluminescence confirms TADF for all investigated compounds except for the DPA derivative. Across the TADF-active series, the singlet–triplet energy gap, ΔEST, decreases from 0.22 to 0.03 eV and the delayed fluorescence lifetime shortens from 8.5 ms to 29 μs. Vacuum-deposited OLEDs with TBCzPyN-PAH showed EQEmax, of 21.6% at an electroluminescence maximum of 538 nm, whereas the device with PXZPyN-PAH emitted at 606 nm and showed a lower EQEmax of 7.2% but with a milder efficiency roll-off.
items.authors: Jakub Wagner, Eglė Tankelevičiūtė, Haoyang Li, Tomas Matulaitis, Maja Morawiak, Maciej Jelecki

items.title: Dearomative Multifunctionalization of Benzene Rings Enabled by Electron-Transfer Catalysis
